name: Akeldama
line: Akeldama, meaning Field of Blood, was the potter's field bought with the money paid to Judas, and it became a burial place for foreigners near Jerusalem.

moments.title: The potter's field is bought
moments.text: The leaders used the silver to buy the potter's field as a burial place for foreigners. That is why it has been called the Field of Blood to this day.

moments.title: Judas and the Field of Blood
moments.text: Judas bought a field with the reward for his wickedness, and he fell there and died. Everyone in Jerusalem heard of it, so they called the field Akeldama, which means Field of Blood.
